verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents Insights as server-side analysis covering aggregated query statistics, failing query patterns, resource anomalies, schema recommendations, and top queries ranked by a performance metric. Postgres instance and storage graphs appear on dashboard tabs, and a hands-on user reports the Insights tab surfaced missing indexes. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the dashboard Insights view itself (the cited Insights docs are CLI-focused), and explicit 'slow query' terminology beyond top queries ranked by a performance metric.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see slow queries, index recommendations, and performance metrics in a built-in insights view

citations.quote: Surface PlanetScale's server-side analysis of a database: aggregated query statistics, failing query patterns, resource anomalies, and schema recommendations, all computed from production traffic.
List top queries ranked by a performance metric
Postgres instance, storage, and PgBouncer graphs now live on their own tabs with shareable URLs.
The Insights tab also surfaced missing indexes we added, which sped things up further.
